sentences.en: But, to his credit, he didn't say anything against her.
sentences.zh: 但要给他点赞的是，他没有说她的任何负面评价。

sentences.en: The owner of this bar never sells liquor on credit.
sentences.zh: 这家酒吧的老板从不赊酒。

sentences.en: Unless you have good credit, buying a house is impossible.
sentences.zh: 除非信用良好，否则买房是不可能的。

senses.zh: 信用，信誉；赊账；学分；功劳，荣誉；信贷，贷款
